mapper.sql: p.id, p.bank_id, p.product_name, p.product_code, p.min_amount, p.max_amount, p.min_term_months, p.max_term_months, p.interest_rate, p.description, p.requirements, p.status, p.sort_order, p.remark, p.create_by, p.create_time, p.update_by, p.update_time
mapper.select: SELECT , b.bank_name FROM bank_loan_product p LEFT JOIN bank_info b ON p.bank_id = b.id WHERE p.id = #{id}
SELECT , b.bank_name FROM bank_loan_product p LEFT JOIN bank_info b ON p.bank_id = b.id WHERE p.status = '1' AND b.status = '0' ORDER BY p.sort_order ASC, p.create_time DESC
SELECT , b.bank_name FROM bank_loan_product p LEFT JOIN bank_info b ON p.bank_id = b.id WHERE p.bank_id = #{bankId} ORDER BY p.sort_order ASC, p.create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bank_loan_product (bank_id, product_name, product_code, min_amount, max_amount, min_term_months, max_term_months, interest_rate, description, requirements, status, sort_order, remark, create_by, create_time) VALUES (#{bankId}, #{productName}, #{productCode}, #{minAmount}, #{maxAmount}, #{minTermMonths}, #{maxTermMonths}, #{interestRate}, #{description}, #{requirements}, #{status}, #{sortOrder}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, NOW())
